messages:
laura_sales: Client (RegulaBank) needs a short attestation for a POC: tenant pinned to eu-west-1, no telemetry or analytics leaving EU, list of any edge/CDN partners in APAC, and a clear statement on KMS/BYOK support. They also want an estimated cross-region egress line item in the quote if failover is enabled.

rishi_se: We can do tenant_pin + telemetry_gating for the hosted offering. Telemetry and usage metrics can be routed to our EU telemetry collector; by default we don't send customer payloads to external CDNs, only anonymized metrics. Need to call out exceptions (agent-based telemetry and health pings).

chao_infra: Implementation summary:
- Tenant pin: bind serving and KV to eu-west-1 (no automatic replication).
- Failover: optional chain -> eu-central-1 then ap-southeast-1 (explicit consent required).
- Telemetry: service telemetry endpoints can be region-scoped; edge CDN used for control-plane static assets only in APAC (FastEdge), not for request payloads.

rishi_se: Action: produce a one-page attestation PDF and a short tech appendix with routing policy + a snippet showing telemetry exclusion rules. I'll draft the snippet below for the appendix.

chao_infra: routing_policy snippet:

```
mode: tenant_pin
primary: eu-west-1
replication: none
failover: [eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1]  # only after explicit failover trigger
telemetry_paths:
  - /v1/metrics -> eu-telemetry.redwood.internal
  - /v1/usage -> eu-usage.redwood.internal
edge_cdns_allowed:
  - name: fastedge
    region: ap-southeast-1
    role: static_assets_only
    dpa_required: true
```

emma_legal: Legal notes to include in attestation:
- Signed statement: "No customer request payloads will be routed to processors outside the EU except during defined failover events."
- List of subprocessors and certs (ISO27001, SOC2) for each.
- Confirmation: No mainland China subprocessors for this POC.
- DPA status: FastEdge requires our standard DPA + APAC addendum; CloudStore backups are EU-only and under existing DPA.

laura_sales: Pricing ask: they want an explicit egress contingency line (in case failover occurs). Can we provide a simple calc and a conservative estimate to include in the quote?

rishi_se: Proposed egress contingency formula for the quote: "Contingency egress = estimated_peak_rps * avg_request_bytes * expected_failover_minutes * 60 * safety_multiplier * region_egress_rate". We should provide a worked example for their expected 200 RPS baseline.

chao_infra: Example numbers to include in appendix (for the worked example):
- peak_rps: 200
- avg_request_bytes: 15000 (15KB per session)
- expected_failover_minutes: 30
- safety_multiplier: 1.5
- eu->ap_e_gross_rate: $0.09/GB

ops-bot: docs-publish: sales/poc-attachments updated (sha: f9d8e7). PDF attestation draft available at /docs/poc/1709999999-attestation-draft.pdf

emma_legal: I'll attach subprocessors cert list + a one-paragraph attestation template. Please confirm FastEdge contact prior to finalizing the DPA ask.

laura_sales: Great. Can we have the one-pager + appendix ready within 6 hours? I have a 1pm demo tomorrow. If FastEdge DPA is missing, flag it as a pre-req.

rishi_se: I'll send the tech appendix and the worked egress calc by EOD.

chao_infra: I'll verify KMS: AWS KMS in eu-west-1 available for hosted BYOK; for ap-southeast-1 keys we have AWS KMS, but BYOK workflow requires keystore proxy registration. Note: for Dedicated we can fully onboard third-party KMS like Azure KeyVault per customer request.

laura_sales: Thanks team. Marking blockers: FastEdge DPA (pending), formal attestation (in progress).
